tactics:
intro α l₁ l₂ h <;> induction h with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x _ ih => exact ih.append_left x
  | swap x y l => simp only [List.flatten_cons, ← List.append_assoc]; exact List.perm_append_comm.append_right _
  | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2
intro α l₁ l₂ h <;> induction h <;> simp_all [List.perm_append_comm, ← List.append_assoc]
